encounter: E0194 TRAINER_CAROLINA (Route108, Feather Badge, cap 48, Medium)
availability_audit: Route 108 is the sea route to the Abandoned Ship, reached by Surf after the Balance Badge; battle index window 48-60, floor 48. Every member is gated at 36 or below in pool-48.json: Haunter plus Linking Cord (30), New Mauville entrance and interior via Wattson's Basement Key (30), Granite Cave Abra plus Slateport Linking Cord (20), Togepi Route 102 plus Shiny Stone (24), Sneasel (14). All precede the first Surf. No legendaries, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species.
plan: Carolina's four split cleanly by what blanks them. Gengar is immune to both of the room's Fighting moves at once - Hawlucha's Close Combat and Kommo-o's Body Press - and its Sludge Bomb is 2x on Mega Gardevoir while Psychic is 2x on the other two. Magnezone is the second wall: Steel resists Fairy, Psychic, Flying, Ice and Dragon, which is most of what Carolina throws, and Flash Cannon is 2x back into Gardevoir. Togekiss is here for one number - Fairy is 4x on Kommo-o's Dragon/Fighting - and Weavile's Fake Out is the priority denial the dossier's crack names, aimed at the Swords Dance or the Close Combat turn that Hawlucha needs to start its White Herb into Unburden sequence. The thing to watch is that sequence: Close Combat drops Hawlucha's defences, the White Herb erases the drops, the consumed Herb triggers Unburden and its Speed doubles, so the cheapest answer is to make it switch or to kill it before the third step.
